decisions.reason: As a core-adjacent camera with an established product page and no clear negative signal, it remains a low-cost option worth keeping open in a growing space market.
The modular multi-model line reflects stronger commitment and broad mission fit, so management would be unlikely to abandon it while uncertainty can still resolve favorably.
Although more exploratory than standard camera offers, it still leverages existing capabilities and the firm can afford to wait for space situational awareness demand to mature.
Its lighter website presence keeps exit risk above the other core products, but miniaturized space-qualified LiDAR matches the firm's strategic direction closely enough to preserve the option.
A radiation-hard camera line with several models and its own page signals meaningful commitment in a core technical domain, making near-term withdrawal unlikely.
This is a narrower and more mission-specific option with less visible market commitment, but it builds on the firm's heritage and is still worth keeping until demand becomes clearer.
